honest_caveats_c3: C1 — shellcheck not installed on mac; syntax verification fell back to `bash -n` only. bash -n catches parser errors but NOT semantic issues like quoting, unused vars, ShellCheck SC2086 word-splitting, etc. Recommend installing shellcheck (brew install shellcheck) and re-running before final operator execution.

C2 — Dry-run only verified GATE 1 (review window). GATE 2 (HF state intact via `secret` CLI + curl + python3 parse) was NOT exercised by the dry-run because GATE 1 short-circuits abort; this is by design but means GATE 2's curl + python3 parse path remains unvalidated until real-time execution post-window-close. Mitigation: independent ad-hoc HF API curl in this verify cycle confirmed both repos return private+sha+siblings exactly matching script EXPECTED_* constants — equivalent coverage achieved out-of-band.

C3 — Pβ promote G5 gate (base model promotion status) is a NEW gate not present in clm template. Operator must verify base need-singularity/clm-v4-mk2-v1 has been public-promoted FIRST; otherwise non-auth readers cannot load the Pβ adapter (PEFT requires base + adapter both accessible). Order of operations matters: clm-v4-mk2-v1 promote MUST precede pbeta promote.

C4 — secret CLI on mac may return rotated/stale token (see verdict §C7 of pbeta upload). Both scripts call `secret get huggingface.token --raw` and validate `hf_*` prefix only; they do NOT validate `whoami` against HF API. If mac secret store has hf_asc... (rotated) instead of hf_dw... (working), GATE 2 will pass shape check but curl will return 401. Recommend re-syncing mac secret store before scheduled execution OR running scripts from ubu1 where ~/.cache/huggingface/token is known-working.

C5 — Mac stage mirrors are retained by default (cleanup `--delete-mac-mirror` opt-in flag). This is conservative for clm (3 files small) and Pβ (5 files ~76MB). Pβ mac mirror at ~76MB is borderline; if disk pressure justifies, operator should pass --delete-mac-mirror after confirming HF Hub canonical copy is intact.

C6 — No git commit in this BG (per task CRITICAL). All 4 scripts on disk including 2 newly authored ones; operator must commit them in a follow-up cycle (or accept they live in state/ which is gitignored anyway — both pbeta scripts are inside state/p9_pbeta_hf_upload_2026_05_05/ which IS gitignored; this is fine for execution but means scripts are not version-tracked).

C7 — bash version on mac is /bin/bash 3.2 (system bash). Both scripts use `[[ ... < ... ]]` ISO-8601 string comparison which works in bash 3.2+ as lexicographic comparison and is correct for fixed-format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ strings (no DST/timezone ambiguity since both sides UTC). Confirmed working by all 4 dry-runs.
